name: soundlink
description: Connect Meta ads to Spotify listening: compare attributed listeners, cost per listener, and repeat listening with Soundlink.

interface.longDescription: Soundlink connects Meta ads to actual Spotify listening behavior. See which campaigns and creatives bring attributed listeners, compare cost per listener, and explore whether listeners come back and play more of your catalog. For artists, managers, labels, and music marketing teams. Get recommendations grounded in your Soundlink data. Access is read-only; campaign and budget changes stay in Soundlink. Sign in to connect one organization.
defaultPrompt: Which of my Soundlink campaigns brought listeners most efficiently over the last seven complete days?
Which creatives have the lowest lifetime cost per attributed listener in my latest campaign?
Are listeners coming back, and what else are they playing while my campaign is active?

prompts: Which of my Soundlink campaigns brought listeners most efficiently over the last seven complete days?
Which creatives have the lowest lifetime cost per attributed listener in my latest campaign?
Are listeners coming back, and what else are they playing while my campaign is active?

positive.description: Setup: sign in to a dedicated review organization with at least two campaigns, one with metrics in the last seven complete days. List the organization’s campaigns.
positive.prompt: Show my Soundlink campaigns and their current status.
positive.expected_behavior: List only campaigns returned for the connected organization, preserving names, IDs, and statuses. Follow pagination when needed to satisfy the request; do not invent campaigns.

positive.description: Setup: same review organization, with at least one campaign that has metrics in the last seven complete days. Select its most recently started campaign from returned campaign data.
positive.prompt: For my most recently started Soundlink campaign, summarize performance over the last seven complete days.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the campaign from returned data, use its actual campaignId, and request the last seven complete days with explicit startDate and endDate. Summarize only returned metrics, including units and currency where supplied; do not sum daily listeners. Prioritize attributed listeners, returned cpl, and streams_per_listener over clicks. Use overview totals, distinguish new listeners from total listeners, and do not divide spend by Spotify for Artists audience totals.

positive.description: Setup: the most recently started campaign has at least two creatives with lifetime metrics.
positive.prompt: Which creatives have the lowest lifetime cost per attributed listener in my latest campaign?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve a real campaignId and request creatives without dates. Label the comparison lifetime; rank by returned CPL when available, considering listener volume and missing values. Do not invent spend, treat the first row as a proven winner, or claim a change was made.

positive.description: Setup: the connected review organization has at least one standalone soundlink. Campaign-created soundlinks are outside this tool’s catalog.
positive.expected_behavior: Show standalone soundlinks from the tool response and follow pagination as needed. Do not claim this list includes campaign-created soundlinks or other organizations’ links.

positive.description: Setup: the review organization has a wallet and wallet:read permission. No wallet mutation is required.
positive.prompt: What is my Soundlink wallet balance?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the returned balance using the response’s currency and units. Do not claim to top up the wallet, move funds, or make a purchase.

positive.description: Setup: an active campaign has daily breakdown and catalog engagement rows.
positive.prompt: Are listeners coming back to my active campaign, and which other tracks are they playing over the last seven complete days?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the campaign and dates; inspect returning_listeners in breakdown and catalog engagement by track. Follow pagination for the requested window. Distinguish repeat-listening counts from cohort retention, never sum daily listeners into unique listeners, and do not interpret partial post-campaign data as churn.

negative.description: Budget writes are unsupported. Explain the read-only limit without attempting a write or claiming the requested change succeeded.
negative.prompt: Double the budget of every active Soundlink campaign now.

negative.description: Video imports and campaign creation are unsupported. Do not attempt an import or creation, and do not fabricate a completed action.
negative.prompt: Import a video into Soundlink and use it to launch a new campaign.

negative.description: One connection grants access to one organization. Do not query the connected organization as a substitute or claim access to the other organization. Ask the user to reconnect and consent to the intended organization.
negative.prompt: Without reconnecting, show the wallet balance of a different Soundlink organization that I have not connected here.

negative.description: Lifetime creative reports do not support dates. Explain that limitation; daily creative metrics support media spend, impressions and followers but cannot establish a seven-day creative CPL ranking. Do not silently substitute lifetime results.
negative.prompt: Which creative had the lowest cost per listener over the last seven days?

publication.release_notes: Focus prompts and shared guidance on Spotify listener attribution, cost per listener, creative comparisons, and repeat listening. Correct lifetime creative reporting examples and clarify metric aggregation.
